key_insight: Full-potential KKR accurately describes diamond-structured Si and predicts composition-dependent structural properties and unfavorable mixing energetics in SiGeSn alloys.
engineering_relevance: KKR-FP in MuST offers a first-principles framework for assessing lattice compatibility, stiffness, and alloying energetics in group-IV semiconductor materials.
method: Benchmark full-potential KKR against muffin-tin and atomic sphere approximations for Si.
Extend calculations to elemental Ge and Sn.
Calculate SiGeSn equilibrium lattice parameters, bulk moduli, and mixing enthalpies.
evidence_signal: For Si, KKR-FP yields an equilibrium lattice parameter of 5.433 Å and bulk modulus of 94.9 GPa; two SiGeSn compositions have positive mixing enthalpies of 180.92 and 346.32 meV/atom.
watch_item: Positive mixing enthalpies are relative to selected elemental reference states and do not alone establish finite-temperature alloy stability.
paper_title: Full-Potential Korringa Kohn Rostoker Study of Structural and Mechanical Properties in SiGeSn Alloys
